_meta.indication: Topical treatment of molluscum contagiosum (MC) in adults and pediatric patients 1 year of age and older

pivotal_trials.population: Male and female patients ≥6 months of age with molluscum contagiosum, with between 3 and 70 MC lesions at baseline
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving complete clearance (total MC lesion count of 0) at Week 12
pivotal_trials.result: Complete clearance at Week 12: 32.4% vs 19.7% vehicle (treatment difference 12.8%, 95% CI 7.1%, 18.6%; p<0.0001); key secondary at Week 8: 19.6% vs 11.6% (p=0.0012)

pivotal_trials.population: Male and female patients ≥6 months of age with molluscum contagiosum, with between 3 and 70 MC lesions at baseline
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects with complete clearance of all treatable MC lesions at Week 12
pivotal_trials.result: Complete clearance at Week 12: 30.0% vs 20.3% vehicle (treatment difference 9.2%, 95% CI -0.04%, 18.4%); primary endpoint just missed significance (p=0.0510)

pivotal_trials.population: Male and female patients ≥6 months of age with molluscum contagiosum, with between 3 and 70 MC lesions at baseline
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects with complete clearance of all treatable MC lesions at Week 12
pivotal_trials.result: Complete clearance at Week 12: 25.8% vs 21.6% vehicle (treatment difference 4.3%, 95% CI -5.0%, 13.6%); not statistically significant (p=0.3637); did not demonstrate efficacy on the primary endpoint

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥1%) were application site reactions: pain (18.7%), erythema (11.7%), pruritus (5.7%), exfoliation (5.0%), dermatitis (4.9%), swelling (3.5%), erosion (1.6%), discoloration (1.5%), vesicles (1.5%), irritation (1.2%), and infection (1.1%)
target_moa: Nitric oxide (NO) releasing agent; the exact mechanism of action for the treatment of molluscum contagiosum is unknown
modality: Small molecule (topical nitric oxide-releasing agent; berdazimer sodium)

rems.type: No REMS required; risk mitigation measures beyond professional labeling and standard postmarketing surveillance are not warranted

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held; there were no efficacy, safety, or novel/complex regulatory issues that required input

summary.text: Standard 505(b)(1) NDA for berdazimer sodium (a new molecular entity nitric oxide-releasing agent) approved via a full (traditional) approval based on adequate and well-controlled Phase 3 trials; no accelerated approval, priority review, or other expedited designations, and no PMRs were required.

citations.quote: The Applicant submitted a 505(b)(1) application for their proposed product, SB206 (berdazimer) gel, 10.3% to treat molluscum contagiosum in adults and pediatric patients 1 year of age and older.
The review team recommends that no PMRs be required for this product based on their review of the data submitted to this NDA.
